description: Sustained inflation while a competing upload runs, then recovery with cooldown once the upload stops.

timeline.note: baseline window (0-60s) complete after this; p50 ~= 20ms
upload starts; window 1 of sustained inflation, p95 ~= 74ms, inflation ~= 54ms
window 3 of sustained inflation -> degradeSustainedWindows satisfied as of this window's close (t=90)
upload stops right after this window
window 2 back under recoverInflationMs -> recoverSustainedWindows satisfied as of this window's close (t=140)

expectedStates.reason: only 2 of the required 3 consecutive violating windows have closed so far
three consecutive windows (60-70, 70-80, 80-90) each exceeded +50ms inflation
sustained congestion continues while load evidence persists
only 1 of the required 2 consecutive recovery windows has closed so far
two consecutive windows (120-130, 130-140) back under +25ms inflation
still within the 20s cooldown dwell that started at 140s
cooldown elapsed with inflation staying low throughout; stable baseline resumed

notes: This is the primary sustained-congestion + recovery + cooldown case. The exact window boundaries matter: tests built from this fixture should assert state at both the instant a transition is expected and one window earlier, to catch off-by-one-window bugs in the sustained/cooldown counters (see the t=89/t=90 and t=139/t=140 pairs above). Mitigation (sending a rate-limit recommendation to a cooperating uploader) is explicitly out of scope for PP-005 — this fixture only exercises the detector's own state machine (unknown/healthy/degraded/recovering), not PP-012's policy layer.
